title: (Senior) Manager – AI Automation & Integration Engineer
description: Du willst nicht nur Code schreiben – Du willst mit AI coden, Systeme intelligent vernetzen und Automatisierungen bauen, die echten Business Impact haben? Dann werde Teil unseres IT & Digital Teams bei FUTRUE, einem globalen Healthcare-Vorreiter mit über 20 innovativen Unternehmen! In dieser Rolle arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle von AI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung, Prozessautomatisierung und Systemintegration. Du nutzt modernste AI Coding Tools wie Claude Code, agentic Coding-Plattformen oder vergleichbare Ansätze, um sowohl n8n-Workflows als auch maßgeschneiderte Lösungen zu entwickeln. Gleichzeitig treibst Du den Aufbau von AI Agent Team Members voran – intelligente, autonome Systeme, die unsere Teams im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen. Wenn Du technische Tiefe, Eigenverantwortung und die Chance suchst, AI-First-Arbeitsweisen in einem dynamischen Healthcare-Konzern mitzugestalten – dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig! Deine Aufgaben Integration & Automation Du konzipierst, implementierst und betreibst robuste Integrationen zwischen SaaS- und On-Prem-Systemen und designst dafür passende APIs (REST/GraphQL), Webhooks und Event-Flows. Du entwickelst, versionierst und betreibst n8n-Workflows – von einfachen Automatisierungen bis hin zu komplexen, mehrstufigen Prozess-Orchestrierungen – inklusive Custom Code (TypeScript/Python) und wiederverwendbarer Connectoren. Du erstellst komplexe Daten-Mappings sowie Transformationslogiken und stellst dabei Datenqualität, Idempotenz und hohe Fehlerrobustheit sicher. AI-Powered Development & AI Agents Du nutzt AI Coding Tools (z.B. Claude Code, Open Code, Antigravity oder vergleichbar) produktiv und routiniert, um Entwicklungsgeschwindigkeit und Codequalität zu maximieren – und bringst uns Richtung Enterprise-grade AI Coding. Du kannst aber auch selbst coden – Du verstehst, was unter der Haube passiert, reviewst AI-generierte Codes kritisch und greifst ein, wo es nötig ist. Du konzipierst und baust AI Agent Team Members auf: autonome oder semi-autonome AI-Agenten, die Fachbereiche bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben, Datenanalysen oder Entscheidungsprozessen unterstützen. Du evaluierst und integrierst LLM-APIs und AI-Services in unsere Automatisierungslandschaft. Operations & Quality Du richtest Monitoring, Logging und Alerting für alle Integrationen und AI-Agents ein und führst bei Störungen systematische Root-Cause-Analysen durch. Du etablierst stabile Betriebs- und Störungsprozesse (Runbooks, SLIs/SLOs) und setzt Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen um. Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachbereichen zusammen, um Prozesse zu analysieren, Automatisierungspotenziale zu heben und AI-Agent-Use-Cases zu identifizieren. Du erstellst klare, wartungsfreundliche Dokumentation und definierst Best Practices für Integrationsmuster und AI-gestützte Entwicklung. Dein Profil Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder eine gleichwertige Qualifikation. Du bringst einschlägige Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung, Systemintegration und/oder Prozessautomatisierung mit – idealerweise in einem Umfeld mit mehreren Systemwelten. Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in TypeScript und/oder Python und einen sicheren Umgang mit REST/JSON, Webhooks, Event-Architekturen, Git und CI/CD-Pipelines. Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit Workflow-/Automation-Plattformen (bevorzugt n8n), inklusive der Entwicklung eigener Nodes/Module, und Praxis in der Anbindung von SaaS- und On-Prem-Systemen (OAuth2, API Keys, Daten-Mapping/Transformation). Du nutzt AI Coding Tools aktiv und produktiv (z.B. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, agentic Coding-Tools) und verstehst, wie man AI-gestützt enterprise-fähigen Code entwickelt. Du hast Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an LLMs, AI-Agenten und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse (z.B. über LangChain, n8n AI Nodes, eigene Agent-Architekturen). Du überzeugst durch starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit und kannst sowohl mit technischen als auch nicht-technischen Stakeholdern auf Augenhöhe arbeiten. Du bist ein Teamplayer (w/m/d) mit hohem Qualitäts- und Verantwortungsbewusstsein und einer strukturierten, lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise. Du rundest Dein Profil mit fließenden Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnissen ab. Über uns FUTRUE ist mehr als eine international ausgerichtete Healthcare-Gruppe! Mit mittlerweile über 20 Unternehmen und mehr als 90 Arzneimittelzulassungen sind wir u.a. in den Bereichen Brain-Computer-Interfaces, Mikrobiomtherapie, innovative Schmerztherapien sowie chemiefreie Arzneimittel weltweit führend. Zahlreiche unserer Unternehmen, darunter z.B. FUTRUE Neurosciences, SYNformulas, Vertanical und PharmaSGP, gehören zu den weltweit am schnellsten wachsenden Healthcare-Unternehmen. Um diesen Erfolg fortzuführen, setzen wir auf eine neue Generation dynamischer Talente, die den Mut haben, ungewohnte Wege zu gehen. Unser Ziel, so vielen Menschen wie möglich ein neues Leben zu schenken! Willst Du die Zukunft mitgestalten? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt! Unser Versprechen Wir bieten Dir einen vielfältigen, anspruchsvollen Job mit spannenden Aufgaben und einem breiten Spektrum an Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten! Unser innovatives Umfeld ermöglicht Dir Deine berufliche Entfaltung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, Verantwortung von Tag 1 an und den Freiraum, neue Wege zu gehen. Auf Dich wartet individuelles Learning und echte Sinnhaftigkeit – schenke mit Deinem persönlichen Beitrag Millionen von Menschen ein neues Leben! *Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird in dieser Anzeige die männliche Form verwendet. Sie bezieht sich ausdrücklich auf alle Geschlechter (w/m/d).

Your Impact

As a Senior Backend Engineer (m/f/d) at 7Mind, you’ll be part of a cross-functional team building technology that supports mental wellbeing at scale. You work end-to-end on features, take ownership of backend services and help shape a system that is reliable, maintainable and a pleasure to work with.


In 2025, we fully rewrote and relaunched the 7Mind app and backend. Our new platform follows Domain-Driven Design principles and deliberately focuses on “delightfully boring” solutions: simple, robust and built to last.


7Mind is part of the 7NXT Health Group (BuddyFit, Gymondo), bringing together strong engineering culture and a clear purpose: empowering people to live healthier lives.


Your Mission

  • Build and evolve backend features end-to-end: from concept and implementation to deployment and monitoring

  • Write clean, testable and maintainable code with a strong focus on long-term quality

  • Maintain and improve integrations with third-party services

  • Ensure a stable, observable and scalable backend in a B2C environment

  • Take and share ownership of your services and share responsibility for the overall system

  • Discuss trade-offs openly with product, design and other stakeholders

  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture through code reviews, documentation and knowledge sharing


Our Tech Stack

We use modern, well-proven tools and value pragmatic choices over unnecessary complexity:



  • Golang

  • Elixir (with Phoenix, Broadway)

  • AWS, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Google PubSub, OpenTelemetry, Terraform

  • Github, Github Actions, Linear, DataDog, Google Cloud, Cloudflare


Your Story

  • 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering, with a strong focus on backend development

  • Proficiency in Golang with at least 4+ years writing production code

  • Solid understanding of web fundamentals (HTTP, REST, caching, cookies, WebSockets, asset loading)

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-based deployments

  • A strong sense for clean architecture, maintainable and testable code

  • Product mindset: you balance technical excellence with user value and business impact

  • Clear communication and documentation skills in English


Nice to Have:



  • Experience or interest in mobile or web development

  • Experience with Elixir (Phoenix, Broadway)

  • Kubernetes configuration or administration

  • Linux system administration

  • Google Cloud


Our Benefits - Just for You

Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place - physically, mentally, and within the team:



  • 30 days of vacation per year

  • 2 additional days off: December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year's Eve) are officially recognized as paid holidays.

  • Hybrid working model (3 days in the office, 2 days working from home)

  • 4 weeks of work from abroad per year

  • A free Urban Sports Club M membership & access to Nilo Health for mental health and personal development

  • Free access to our digital wellbeing products (7Mind & Gymondo)

  • Monthly mobility budget of €30 via Navit

  • Family-friendly benefits: childcare costs & sick days for children

  • The office classics: fruit & vegetable basket, muesli & yogurt (also vegan), drinks & snacks

  • A wide range of opportunities for personal growth and development - including a €1,000 annual training budget

  • Four-legged colleagues are welcome in our pet-friendly office!


Come as you are

We welcome what makes you unique.

At 7NXT, Gymondo and 7Mind, we believe in diversity, openness and team spirit. No matter which gender you identify with, whether you have a disability, what your neurotype is, where you come from, what you believe in or how you love - you are welcome here.


Don't meet all the criteria? No problem. If you would like to shape the future of health & well-being with us, we look forward to receiving your application.


Do you need a more accessible application process or do you have questions about the procedure? Write to us and we'll find a way.

title: Full‑Stack SAP Developer (ABAP & Fiori/UI5)
description: Location : Romania or Germany (remote or hybrid) Contract : Full time & Indefinite Language(s) : English Serrala is the global leader in finance process automation. For over 40 years, we have been advancing the office of the CFO with our award-winning suite of finance automation applications. Our solutions streamline all working capital-related processes, including Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Cash Flow Management, and Treasury, across both cloud and SAP environments. Our 10+ hubs across Europe, North America, and India support over 2,800 clients worldwide, reflecting the trust we've built with a diverse global community. Join us as we lead the future of finance automation! About The Role As a Full‑Stack SAP Developer (ABAP & Fiori/UI5) , you will design, develop, and deliver scalable business applications on SAP while following clean‑core principles. You will collaborate closely with the Product Owner, contribute to technical design decisions, and ensure high‑quality, production‑ready code within an Agile environment. Main Responsibilities Analyze requirements, design solutions with the Product Owner, and identify dependencies. Lead and contribute to the technical design process, including documentation, impact analysis, and proof‑of‑concept creation. Break down user stories, estimate and plan implementation, write clean and efficient code, maintain documentation, and ensure production readiness. You'll contribute to the evolution of modern agentic AI systems while improving developer experience, architecture, and platform standards. Build and enhance Kotlin/Spring Boot backend services and client libraries that serve as core platform building blocks. Mentor engineering teams on AI agent development, providing technical guidance on Python-based frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph while promoting engineering best practices. Lead the strategy for evaluating AI systems, measuring quality, reliability, and regression through robust testing and observability approaches. Research emerging technologies, prototype innovative solutions, and transform successful concepts into production-ready platform capabilities. Improve developer experience by creating clear documentation, intuitive APIs, useful tooling, and well-designed development workflows. Collaborate across engineering teams to understand platform needs, influence architectural decisions, conduct design and code reviews, and promote adoption of shared platform standards. Requirements 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, including extensive work building frameworks, libraries, platform services, or reusable developer tooling. Strong expertise in Kotlin, JVM technologies, and Spring Boot with deep understanding of API design, software architecture, and scalable backend development. Demonstrated technical leadership with the ability to drive architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and influence technical direction across multiple teams. Strong interest in AI technologies and a willingness to become a subject matter expert in agentic AI frameworks, orchestration, evaluation, and guardrail systems. Experience solving ambiguous technical challenges by translating complex requirements into scalable, maintainable platform solutions. Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to design solutions that consider the broader engineering ecosystem and long-term scalability. Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly. Working knowledge of Python and the ability to contribute effectively across both Kotlin and Python technology stacks. Experience with distributed systems, cloud platforms (preferably AWS), infrastructure as code, messaging systems, gRPC, event-driven architectures, or developer experience initiatives is considered an advantage. title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer – AI-Native Software Development
description: At JetBrains, code is our passion. Ever since we started, back in 2000, we have strived to make the strongest, most effective developer tools on earth. By automating routine checks and corrections, our tools speed up production, freeing developers to grow, discover, and create. We just unveiled JetBrains Central, a platform for agent-driven software development that connects tools, agents, and infrastructure. It enables automated AI workflows to run, be monitored, and be managed across teams – with clear visibility into results, costs, and performance. JetBrains Central Provides Three Core Capabilities Governance and control: Policy enforcement, identity and access management, observability, auditability, and cost attribution for agent-driven work. Some of these functionalities are already available via the JetBrains Central Console. Agent execution infrastructure: Cloud agent runtimes and computation provisioning that allow agents to run reliably across development environments. Agent optimization and context: Shared semantic context across repositories and projects, enabling agents to access relevant knowledge, and task routing to the most appropriate models or tools. Inside the Professional Services department, we are building a team of Forward Deployed Engineers to help our customers adopt AI-native development with JetBrains Central and enable JetBrains consulting partners to transform their customers’ AI-native software development lifecycle. About The Role As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, you will work directly with early adopter customers to deploy JetBrains Central platform into complex enterprise environments and help them move from experimental AI usage to governed, scalable AI-native development. You will act as a trusted advisor to customer engineering teams and consulting partners, while also mentoring other Forward Deployed Engineers and helping with complex deployments. In this role, you will help establish best practices for enterprise AI adoption and influence how organizations implement AI-driven software development. This role is often a strong fit for engineers who have previously served as Principal or Staff Engineers, Heads of Engineering, CTOs, or Solutions Architects and who enjoy working directly with customers while staying deeply involved with complex technical systems. This role combines consulting, architecture, and hands-on engineering. Your work in the field will directly influence how our platform evolves and how enterprises adopt AI-driven development. You will work directly with the world’s most innovative companies — our client base includes 420 of the Fortune 500 — ensuring they maximize the value of their JetBrains investments. What You’ll Do Deploy JetBrains Central platform into enterprise development environments, CI/CD systems, and internal developer platforms. Help organizations transition from ad-hoc AI experimentation to governed AI-native development workflows. Implement enterprise AI governance, including security policies, access management, and data privacy controls. Enable observability for AI-driven development to help organizations understand their AI usage and its impact on productivity, as well as their code-generation patterns. Design sustainable AI adoption strategies, including usage controls and cost visibility across multiple model providers. Integrate our cloud-based agent execution layer, allowing AI agents to run securely and at scale. Collaborate closely with JetBrains product teams to shape the platform based on real-world deployments and customer feedback. Create delivery frameworks and train JetBrains partners to deliver the desired scope of service. Mentor and support other Forward Deployed Engineers, sharing architectural expertise and helping to scale the team’s deployment practices. You will thrive in this role if you are A consultant at heart who can communicate effectively with both engineers and technical leadership. Able to see the whole picture of the software development lifecycle across developer tools, infrastructure, APIs, and cloud systems. Experienced at integrating complex software systems into enterprise environments. Curious about the future of AI agents and AI-native software development. Comfortable working with early adopters and overcoming ambiguous technical challenges. Motivated to mentor other engineers and contribute to building a new technical discipline. What You Will Bring Experience in software-related projects, ideally in a customer-facing or consulting environment. Familiarity with Java or Python. Experience building or integrating developer platforms, infrastructure systems, or software solutions. Familiarity with modern development workflows (CI/CD, developer environments, internal developer platforms, etc.). Experience working directly with customers or technical stakeholders. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to operate in fast-evolving technical environments. Ability and desire to travel to meet customers. Experience in solutions engineering, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering roles. Familiarity with the JetBrains ecosystem or developer productivity tooling. description_raw:
JOIN OUR TEAM

As a Senior Software Engineer on our Web & API team, you will play a key role in shaping and evolving our e-commerce storefront. Working across the full stack, from React components and data integrations to AI-powered features, you will take ownership of complex features end-to-end, from specification and architecture through to delivery and monitoring. In close collaboration with Product and Design in an agile environment, you will combine a keen eye for performance with a drive to build experiences that delight millions of customers. Your curiosity for emerging technologies will help the team work smarter, ship faster, and continuously push the boundaries of what is possible. This position is permanent and based in Munich.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Design, build, and maintain features end-to-end across the storefront and mobile API, from specification through server-side data loading and UI to production release and maintenance
  • Build and extend integrations with our e-commerce, headless CMS, search, analytics, and experimentation platforms
  • Build AI-powered user-facing features, directing and reviewing AI coding agents in your own and the team's workflow while owning the correctness, security, and maintainability of everything that ships
  • Own the caching, rendering, and performance strategy for the storefront and mobile API
  • Partner with Product Managers and Designers to turn business goals into performant, high-quality user experiences
  • Champion code quality and reliability through testing, code reviews, and the conventions and context that keep the codebase healthy for both engineers and AI agents as it grows

YOU COME WITH

  • Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, and modern frontend development, backed by strong software architecture skills and solid engineering principles
  • A sharp focus on performance across the stack, from frontend rendering to backend data fetching, including server-side rendering (ideally with React Router) and GraphQL
  • Strong specification and architecture judgment, turning ambiguous requests into precise, testable specs that teammates and coding agents build against, while making load-bearing technical decisions with confidence
  • Rigorous approach to code verification, designing the tests, evals, and checks that determine production readiness without relying on surface-level outputs
  • High standards for maintainability, resilience, security, and cost efficiency, reasoning through failure modes and remaining especially vigilant when reviewing AI-generated code
  • Proven fluency with Agentic AI, directing coding agents on well-scoped work, reviewing output with informed scepticism, owning the result, and leveraging AI to accelerate delivery and power user-facing features
  • A product-driven mindset that connects technical decisions to business impact and user experience, with prior experience in Product Engineering or Product Management considered a plus
  • Fluency in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills

WHY WESTWING

If you are looking for a place where ambition meets creativity, where ideas turn into impact fast, and where people are trusted to grow - you have found it.

At Westwing, we’re building the Superbrand in Design with a team that’s shaping the future of beautiful home & living.

Here is what you can look forward to:

  • A high-performance culture built on trust, feedback and collaboration
  • An inspiring, international environment that empowers you to think big, take ownership, and grow beyond your comfort zone
  • A flexible hybrid setup with ideally 3 office days per week - because strong connections and quick collaboration make great ideas happen
  • Professionally equipped workstation of your personal choice
  • 30 days of paid holiday to rest, recharge, and come back ready to create
  • A beautiful, centrally located, dog-friendly office with inspiring spaces, a sunny terrace, and good food - designed for moments that energise and connect
  • Exclusive discounts - 40% off Westwing Collection, 20% off third-party brands (each on non-reduced items), 10% Family & Friends discount, plus special-occasion vouchers
  • Wellbeing support through mental health resources, sports memberships, and preventive care
  • Sustainable mobility options with discounted public transport and JobRad - moving with purpose and care for the planet
  • Support for working parents, including our on-site Westwing Wichtel daycare and a partnership with multilingual provider Elly & Stoffl
  • One annual Social Impact Day to give back to a cause you care about - because being human is our true superpower
  • Team rituals that celebrate results and togetherness - from Summer & Winter Parties to Oktoberfest

ABOUT US

Westwing, Europe’s #1 in Beautiful Living e-commerce, is present in 20+ European countries and achieved a GMV (Gross Merchandise Volume) of EUR 507 million in 2025. As Europe’s premium one-stop destination for Design Lovers, it offers a unique brand experience with a carefully curated assortment of the Westwing Collection and 3rd party design brands. The integrated platform combines Shop, Daily Specials, Stores, the B2B Service (Westwing Business) and the Westwing Design Service. Einführung automatisierter Test- und Deployment-Prozesse. Kontinuierliche Evaluation neuer KI-Technologien zur strategischen Weiterentwicklung der Plattform (ggf. AWS & Terraform). Du verfügst über erste Erfahrung mit Cloud-Anbietern, idealerweise Microsoft Azure oder AWS. Unternehmerisches Denken bestimmt Deine Entscheidungen. title: Senior Software Engineer, Data Platform Insights
description: About Bolt Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries. From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding. And we're just getting started. Why join Bolt? Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities. Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth. Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry. Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia. About The Role Engineers in the Insights team play a key role in shaping Bolt’s data ecosystem. We own the infrastructure that reliably delivers quality data wherever it’s needed. Data specialists use the tools we build to model and transform raw data into reusable, analysis-ready datasets. We work across the stack - developer tools and frameworks with Python; managing infrastructure with AWS, Terraform, Databricks, and Kubernetes; automations with GitHub Actions and Airflow. We own some data pipelines, but they're not our primary focus. Main Tasks And Responsibilities Own, provision, and improve the cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Databricks, Airflow) that runs 800+ daily workflows and supports thousands of data models and metrics. Build and maintain the internal Python tools and CI/CD pipelines that hide infrastructure complexity, so data teams can validate, test, and release their dbt models and data products more easily. Build and maintain the observability layers, alerting systems, and deployment pipelines that track the platform's health, uptime, and compute costs. Ensure customer success by defining, designing, and delivering intuitive solutions. Our engineers don’t sit and wait for tasks - they shape the platform’s direction. Raise our product and technical quality bar by promoting software engineering best practices. About You You have at least 5 years of software engineering experience, including hands-on work with data-intensive systems and infrastructure-as-code in cloud environments. Proficient in Python or another mainstream OOP language. We care about adaptability and strong engineering fundamentals. You understand modern CI/CD practices and value observability, testing, and automation as core engineering principles. You have excellent communication skills, are fluent in spoken and written English, and you’re comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues. You’re driven by customer success and have a track record of leading and delivering complex, cross-team projects. You’re familiar with modern data stack and platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake / Iceberg, or equivalents).
description_raw:
About Bolt

Bolt is shaping a future where cities are built for people, not cars. What started as an ambitious project of a 19-year-old in 2013 has grown into a global mobility platform used by more than 200 million customers and 4.5 million driver and courier partners across 50 countries.

From ride-hailing and food delivery to scooters, e-bikes, and car-sharing, Bolt helps people move through cities every day. Small, autonomous teams drive this work, combining the speed and ownership of a startup with the scale of a global technology company backed by more than €1bn in funding.

And we're just getting started.

Why join Bolt?

  • Build the future of mobility and help transform how people live and move in cities.
  • Tackle challenges at scale that span technology, operations, regulation, and growth.
  • Take real ownership early. Small, lean teams mean your decisions matter from day one, and you'll learn fast alongside some of the best people in the industry.
  • Join one of Europe's leading technology companies, backed by world-class investors including Sequoia.

About The Role

Engineers in the Insights team play a key role in shaping Bolt’s data ecosystem. We own the infrastructure that reliably delivers quality data wherever it’s needed. Data specialists use the tools we build to model and transform raw data into reusable, analysis-ready datasets.

We work across the stack - developer tools and frameworks with Python; managing infrastructure with AWS, Terraform, Databricks, and Kubernetes; automations with GitHub Actions and Airflow. We own some data pipelines, but they're not our primary focus.

Main Tasks And Responsibilities

  • Own, provision, and improve the cloud infrastructure (AWS, Kubernetes, Databricks, Airflow) that runs 800+ daily workflows and supports thousands of data models and metrics.
  • Build and maintain the internal Python tools and CI/CD pipelines that hide infrastructure complexity, so data teams can validate, test, and release their dbt models and data products more easily.
  • Build and maintain the observability layers, alerting systems, and deployment pipelines that track the platform's health, uptime, and compute costs.
  • Ensure customer success by defining, designing, and delivering intuitive solutions. Our engineers don’t sit and wait for tasks - they shape the platform’s direction.
  • Raise our product and technical quality bar by promoting software engineering best practices.

About You

  • You have at least 5 years of software engineering experience, including hands-on work with data-intensive systems and infrastructure-as-code in cloud environments.
  • Proficient in Python or another mainstream OOP language. We care about adaptability and strong engineering fundamentals.
  • You understand modern CI/CD practices and value observability, testing, and automation as core engineering principles.
  • You have excellent communication skills, are fluent in spoken and written English, and you’re comfortable collaborating with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • You’re driven by customer success and have a track record of leading and delivering complex, cross-team projects.
  • You’re familiar with modern data stack and platforms (Databricks, Delta Lake / Iceberg, or equivalents).

description_raw:
The Position

This role offers more than a position — it provides the opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics within Medicine. As a Senior Data Engineer Medicine & Analytics, you will be part of IT Enterprise Data & Platforms, AI & Platforms and will build and evolve reliable, scalable data products that enable high‑impact insights, accelerate decision‑making, and improve patient outcomes.

You will be a key contributor in delivering a modern data ecosystem across cloud and enterprise platforms. With a strong engineering mindset, you’ll drive change, embrace continuous improvement, and thrive in a fast‑moving environment where priorities evolve day by day.

This position can be filled in different countries: Germany (Ingelheim and Biberach possible) and Spain (Sant Cugat del Vallès).

If you want to apply for the position in Spain, please use this link: Senior Data Engineer Medicine & Analytics .

If you want to apply for the position in Germany click "Apply now".

Discover our Biberach site: xplorebiberach.com

Tasks & Responsibilities

  • You will design, build, and operate end-to-end data pipelines and integrations (batch and event driven), using SnapLogic and AWS services (S3, Lambda, Glue) to ensure scalable ingestion, transformation, and orchestration
  • One of your key tasks will be to develop performant analytics-ready data models and transformation layers, leveraging Snowflake and dbt for modeling, testing, documentation, and efficient deployment
  • You will ensure strong data governance, quality, and lifecycle management, working with Collibra for metadata/lineage and Attaccama for data quality rules, monitoring, and remediation, and supporting product lifecycle processes through Innovator
  • In addition, you will drive engineering excellence and operational reliability, applying best practices in version control, CI/CD, code reviews, observability, alerting, automation, and selfhealing mechanisms
  • Moreover, you will collaborate closely with cross functional partners (Product Owners, Data Scientists, Analysts, Architects, and business stakeholders) to translate needs into reliable, reusable, secure, and compliant data assets


Requirements

  • Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data/Information Systems, or a related field, with several years of relevant experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or similar roles or a bachelor’s degree in these fields with more relevant experience
  • Solid knowledge of software engineering fundamentals (Python/SQL, Git, coding standards, automated testing, and production support practices)
  • Hands-on experience building integrations and pipelines using tools such as SnapLogic (or comparable iPaaS) and cloud services — specifically AWS S3, Lambda, and Glue as well as proven experience with dbt (models, tests, macros, documentation, environments, CI/CD integration) and strong experience with Snowflake including data modeling, performance tuning, and secure data access patterns
  • Familiarity with data governance and metadata management, ideally with Collibra; understanding of lineage, stewardship, and data catalog practices
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage priorities, and proactively drive work forward in a dynamic environment as well as strong stakeholder management, analytical thinking, and structured problem-solving skills
  • Excellent English (oral and written) and communication skills


As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.

Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.

Ready to contact us?

If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Please submit your application documents in English.

Our Company

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

title: Shopware 6 Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d)
description: Einleitung Als Fullservice-Dienstleister im Bereich Werbeartikel und Merchandise bieten wir unseren Kunden kreative Produktlösungen und einen umfassenden Service. Zu unseren spannenden Großkunden zählen namhafte Unternehmen wie Deutsche Bahn, Audi, Ford, Porsche und viele mehr. Für die Weiterentwicklung und den stabilen Betrieb unserer Shopware 6-E-Commerce-Plattform suchen wir einen erfahrenen Full-Stack Developer (m/w/d) . Der Fokus liegt auf Custom Plugins, API-Integrationen und einer sauberen, performanten Shopware-Architektur in einem Inhouse Setup. Deine Aufgaben Weiterentwicklung, Betrieb und technische Optimierung unserer Shopware‑6‑Systeme (Frontend & Backend) Konzeption, Entwicklung und Pflege von Custom Plugins (Erweiterungen, Events, Subscriber) Umsetzung und Betreuung von Integrationen über Shopware Admin API & Store API sowie REST‑Schnittstellen Entwicklung und Dokumentation eigener APIs Anbindung externer Systeme (z. B. ERP, PIM, Zahlungsanbieter) Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung von Storefronts, Themes, CMS‑Elementen und Erlebniswelten Automatisierung technischer Prozesse (z. B. Datenimporte, Cronjobs, Queue‑Systeme, CLI‑Kommandos) Analyse und Optimierung von Performance, Stabilität und Sicherheit (Caching, Core Web Vitals, HTTP‑Cache/CDN, OWASP) Sicherstellung von Code‑Qualität, Wartbarkeit und technischer Dokumentation Dein Profil Must-have Mehrjährige Projekterfahrung mit Shopware 6 (Frontend & Backend) Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PHP (idealerweise PHP 8+) und Symfony Fundierte Erfahrung in der Plugin‑Entwicklung und gutes Verständnis der Shopware‑Architektur (DAL, Services, Dependency Injection) Frontend‑Know‑how: Twig, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, responsives Design Sicherer Umgang mit MySQL/MariaDB und Doctrine ORM Erfahrung mit API‑Anbindungen (REST, optional SOAP) und Systemintegrationen Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise Ausgeprägtes Nutzer‑ und Konsumentenverständnis entlang der gesamten Customer Journey im Onlineshop Team‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeit Nice-to-have Erfahrung mit Unit‑ und Integrationstests Erfahrung mit größeren Automatisierungs‑ oder Importprozessen Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Performance‑ oder Security‑Themen Warum wir? Arbeit an produktiven Shopware‑6‑Systemen mit echtem Business‑Impact Langfristige Perspektive in einem stabilen Inhouse‑Umfeld Klare technische Verantwortung statt Agentur‑Ticketbetrieb Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und IT 30 Tage Urlaub und on top Celebrate your Birthday - 1 Tag frei zum Geburtstag Einfach mal raus? Remote Work (nach Absprache) ist bei uns seit vielen Jahren gesetzt Arzttermin, Sport oder einfach mal was später starten - flexible Arbeitszeit macht es möglich Schlechtes Equipment – nicht bei uns! Bei uns bekommst Du deine individuelle Ausstattung fürs Home Office Beachcup, Statdtlauf, uvm. – nur gemeinsam sind wir stark – deswegen gibt es ganzjährig viele spannende Firmen- und Teamevents Frische Luft zu Mittag – gemeinsam einfach mal in der Mittagspause raus und den Kopf freibekommen für die zweite Runde Gesundheit ist uns wichtig – wir helfen Dir fit und munter zu bleiben durch unsere betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem Gesundheitskonto für Dich, um unterschiedliche Leistungen nutzen zu können, die Du sonst selbst zahlen müsstest Ausreichend Energie für den Tag – mit unseren kostenlosen Getränken, frischem Obst und Gemüse, gemeinsamen Mittagessen und dem besten Kaffee – unserem cyber-Bio-Kaffee kannst Du jederzeit deine Akkus wieder aufladen Du willst langfristig planen? Wir auch! Demnach gehen wir all-in mit deinem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag Dabei sein und dabei bleiben lohnt sich – bei uns kannst Du dich über einen Zuschuss zum Urlaub und für die Geschenke an Weihnachten freuen – Unser Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld kommt on top (gestaffelt nach Zugehörigkeit) Tanken, Einkaufen, uvm. – steuerfrei – mit unserer Spenditkarte (https://www.spendit.de/spenditcard/) gibt es jeden Monat nochmals ein feines Extrabudget zur freien Verfügung Heute schon an morgen gedacht – wir denken mit. Bei uns bekommst Du ein umfassendes Angebot an Altersvorsorge-Möglichkeiten. Unsere Experten beraten dich gerne 5, 10, 15 oder noch länger mit an Bord? Bei uns gibt es immer wieder was kleines sympathisches – zum Jubiläum oder zu deinem Ehrentag „Happy Birthday“! Du bist von deinem Job begeistert und möchtest gerne Freunde, Verwandte oder deine Nachbarn an Bord holen. Das ist uns was wert – jede erfolgreiche Bewerbung lohnt sich – für uns und für dich! Wir sagen schon mal Danke! Du bist gern an der frischen Luft und radelst gerne? Dann lass uns mal über dein neues Bike sprechen. Job Bike ole! Du kommst mit dem eigenen Auto und bist es leid ewig einen Parkplatz zu suchen oder gar einen teuren Stellplatz zu zahlen? Bei uns parkst Du direkt am Gebäude kostenfrei – egal ob mit dem Auto, dem Rad oder dem e-Roller – wir finden schon ein Plätzchen Du ziehst um oder brauchst einfach mal mehr Platz? Dann buch doch einfach kostenfrei einen unserer Transporter. Über uns Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt: Tag für Tag setzen wir uns für ein wertschätzendes Miteinander & den Erfolg unserer Kunden:innen in Deutschland und auf der ganzen Welt ein. Unternehmen mit hohen Ansprüchen, ehrgeizigen Zielen und echter Leidenschaft. Und diese Leidenschaft treibt auch uns immer weiter voran. Der stetige Wandel begleitet uns intern wie extern und wir entwickeln uns konsequent weiter. Deshalb verstärken wir unsere Teams und werden agiler. Wir bieten Dir ein innovatives und modernes Arbeitsumfeld, individuelle Freiräume, gelebte Vielfalt und eine offene Feedbackkultur. Wir wollen mit Dir wachsen und Dich fordern & fördern , um somit gemeinsam die Welt der Arbeit von heute und morgen aktiv zu gestalten. Bei uns hast Du immer die Möglichkeit zum Austausch und Vernetzung. Unser Ziel ist es, Dir individuelle Möglichkeiten zu ermöglichen, um selbstbestimmt arbeiten zu können und eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance zu realisieren. Daher erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Leistungsspektrum für Dich und gestalten einen sicheren zuverlässigen Arbeitsplatz. Mit einer Vielzahl an Optionen ermöglichen wir Dir Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen Dich für die Herausforderungen der Zukunft fit machen und Deine vielseitigen Fähigkeiten durch ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, zugeschnitten auf Deine spezifischen Bedürfnisse, entwickeln und fördern! Es sind herausfordernde Zeiten: Also lass uns die Herausforderungen in Chancen verwandeln & zeig was in Dir steckt. Bewirb Dich noch heute bei uns: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=geklZDUhM_0&t=1s

  • Analyse und Optimierung von Performance, Stabilität und Sicherheit (Caching, Core Web Vitals, HTTP‑Cache/CDN, OWASP)
  • Sicherstellung von Code‑Qualität, Wartbarkeit und technischer Dokumentation

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Mehrjährige Projekterfahrung mit Shopware 6 (Frontend & Backend)
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in PHP (idealerweise PHP 8+) und Symfony
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Plugin‑Entwicklung und gutes Verständnis der Shopware‑Architektur (DAL, Services, Dependency Injection)
  • Frontend‑Know‑how: Twig, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, responsives Design
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MySQL/MariaDB und Doctrine ORM
  • Erfahrung mit API‑Anbindungen (REST, optional SOAP) und Systemintegrationen
  • Strukturierte, eigenverantwortliche und qualitätsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Ausgeprägtes Nutzer‑ und Konsumentenverständnis entlang der gesamten Customer Journey im Onlineshop
  • Team‑ und Kommunikationsfähigkeit

Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Unit‑ und Integrationstests
  • Erfahrung mit größeren Automatisierungs‑ oder Importprozessen
  • Vertiefte Kenntnisse in Performance‑ oder Security‑Themen

Warum wir?

  • Arbeit an produktiven Shopware‑6‑Systemen mit echtem Business‑Impact
  • Langfristige Perspektive in einem stabilen Inhouse‑Umfeld
  • Klare technische Verantwortung statt Agentur‑Ticketbetrieb
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit Fachbereichen und IT
  • 30 Tage Urlaub und on top Celebrate your Birthday - 1 Tag frei zum Geburtstag
  • Einfach mal raus? Remote Work (nach Absprache) ist bei uns seit vielen Jahren gesetzt
  • Arzttermin, Sport oder einfach mal was später starten - flexible Arbeitszeit macht es möglich
  • Schlechtes Equipment – nicht bei uns! Bei uns bekommst Du deine individuelle Ausstattung fürs Home Office
  • Beachcup, Statdtlauf, uvm. – nur gemeinsam sind wir stark – deswegen gibt es ganzjährig viele spannende Firmen- und Teamevents
  • Frische Luft zu Mittag – gemeinsam einfach mal in der Mittagspause raus und den Kopf freibekommen für die zweite Runde
  • Gesundheit ist uns wichtig – wir helfen Dir fit und munter zu bleiben durch unsere betriebliche Krankenversicherung mit einem Gesundheitskonto für Dich, um unterschiedliche Leistungen nutzen zu können, die Du sonst selbst zahlen müsstest
  • Ausreichend Energie für den Tag – mit unseren kostenlosen Getränken, frischem Obst und Gemüse, gemeinsamen Mittagessen und dem besten Kaffee – unserem cyber-Bio-Kaffee kannst Du jederzeit deine Akkus wieder aufladen
  • Du willst langfristig planen? Wir auch! Demnach gehen wir all-in mit deinem unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag
  • Dabei sein und dabei bleiben lohnt sich – bei uns kannst Du dich über einen Zuschuss zum Urlaub und für die Geschenke an Weihnachten freuen – Unser Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld kommt on top (gestaffelt nach Zugehörigkeit)
  • Tanken, Einkaufen, uvm. – steuerfrei – mit unserer Spenditkarte (https://www.spendit.de/spenditcard/) gibt es jeden Monat nochmals ein feines Extrabudget zur freien Verfügung
  • Heute schon an morgen gedacht – wir denken mit. Bei uns bekommst Du ein umfassendes Angebot an Altersvorsorge-Möglichkeiten. Unsere Experten beraten dich gerne
  • 5, 10, 15 oder noch länger mit an Bord? Bei uns gibt es immer wieder was kleines sympathisches – zum Jubiläum oder zu deinem Ehrentag „Happy Birthday“!
  • Du bist von deinem Job begeistert und möchtest gerne Freunde, Verwandte oder deine Nachbarn an Bord holen. Das ist uns was wert – jede erfolgreiche Bewerbung lohnt sich – für uns und für dich! Wir sagen schon mal Danke!
  • Du bist gern an der frischen Luft und radelst gerne? Dann lass uns mal über dein neues Bike sprechen. Job Bike ole!
  • Du kommst mit dem eigenen Auto und bist es leid ewig einen Parkplatz zu suchen oder gar einen teuren Stellplatz zu zahlen? Bei uns parkst Du direkt am Gebäude kostenfrei – egal ob mit dem Auto, dem Rad oder dem e-Roller – wir finden schon ein Plätzchen
  • Du ziehst um oder brauchst einfach mal mehr Platz? Dann buch doch einfach kostenfrei einen unserer Transporter.

Über uns

Bei uns steht der Mensch im Mittelpunkt: Tag für Tag setzen wir uns für ein wertschätzendes Miteinander & den Erfolg unserer Kunden:innen in Deutschland und auf der ganzen Welt ein. Unternehmen mit hohen Ansprüchen, ehrgeizigen Zielen und echter Leidenschaft.

Und diese Leidenschaft treibt auch uns immer weiter voran. Der stetige Wandel begleitet uns intern wie extern und wir entwickeln uns konsequent weiter. Deshalb verstärken wir unsere Teams und werden agiler. Wir bieten Dir ein innovatives und modernes Arbeitsumfeld, individuelle Freiräume, gelebte Vielfalt und eine offene Feedbackkultur.

Wir wollen mit Dir wachsen und Dich fordern & fördern, um somit gemeinsam die Welt der Arbeit von heute und morgen aktiv zu gestalten. Bei uns hast Du immer die Möglichkeit zum Austausch und Vernetzung.

Unser Ziel ist es, Dir individuelle Möglichkeiten zu ermöglichen, um selbstbestimmt arbeiten zu können und eine gesunde Work-Life-Balance zu realisieren. Daher erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Leistungsspektrum für Dich und gestalten einen sicheren zuverlässigen Arbeitsplatz.

Mit einer Vielzahl an Optionen ermöglichen wir Dir Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen Dich für die Herausforderungen der Zukunft fit machen und Deine vielseitigen Fähigkeiten durch ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld, zugeschnitten auf Deine spezifischen Bedürfnisse, entwickeln und fördern!

Es sind herausfordernde Zeiten: Also lass uns die Herausforderungen in Chancen verwandeln & zeig was in Dir steckt. Bewirb Dich noch heute bei uns:

Build the intelligence layer for enterprise customer communication.

AI-native platform  ·  Real customer contacts  ·  Production, not demos.



The Problem We're Solving

Customer communication is one of the largest, most fragmented operational challenges in enterprise — and one of the last areas where AI has not yet delivered on its promise. Companies run dozens of disconnected tools for routing, bots, scheduling, and analytics. Customers still wait. Agents still drown.

The intelligence layer is missing.

virtualQ is building that layer. We are the AI-powered operating system for customer communication — a platform that does not bolt on intelligence, but is built on it. Our system processes tens of thousands of real interactions every day across voice and digital channels, for enterprise clients in insurance, healthcare, and public services. Clients who can't afford downtime, and where compliance isn't optional.

"Configured as-a-prompt. Optimized by experience. Trusted by design."



The Role

You'll work at the intersection of a battle-tested production platform and the next generation of AI architecture. That means taking on real ownership — not just shipping features, but shaping how intelligent systems get built and deployed in high-stakes environments.

This is not a research role. It is not a demo team. Every line of code you write runs in production, affects real people trying to reach help, and integrates with the complex infrastructure of regulated enterprises. The bar is high — and so is the impact.



What You'll Own

You build it, you own it. Here's where you'll have impact:

Core Platform Engineering. Extend and improve our backend services and data pipelines — the foundation everything else runs on. Clean architecture, high availability, real scalability.

LLM Integration in Production. Bring large language models into real customer workflows: decision logic, tool calling, memory, orchestration. Not wrapped in a demo — shipped and monitored in production.

Voice & Conversational AI. Build intelligent voice and chat agents for inbound and outbound use cases, including speech recognition, dialogue management, and integration with contact center infrastructure.

Agentic Systems. Design and implement autonomous workflows — agents that plan, decide, and interact with internal services, embedded in auditable and controllable system boundaries.

AI Quality & Observability. Ensure AI-driven features are traceable, testable, and compliant. In regulated environments, explainability and reliability are not nice-to-haves.



The Stack

We are not starting from scratch — and that is a good thing. Our platform is proven in production. We are expanding it deliberately toward AI-native architecture:

Backend

Ruby on Rails  ·  Python  ·  Elixir

Frontend

React · TypeScript · Tailwind · shadcn · Vite

Infrastructure

Cloud native AWS, all-in · Docker

AI & ML

LLM orchestration  ·  Voice AI (STT / TTS / NLU)  ·  ML optimization models

Telco

Deutsche Telekom  ·  Twilio



What We're Looking For

You bring:

✓  Several years of experience in backend or platform engineering — you've shipped and maintained production systems and know the difference between code that works and code that lasts.

✓  Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, testing, observability — not because someone told you to, but because you've felt the pain of the alternative.

✓  Genuine curiosity about — and ideally hands-on experience with — LLMs, conversational AI, or agentic systems. Not just read about it; actually built something.

✓  Ownership mentality. You take on a problem, drive it forward, and flag issues early. You don't wait to be asked.

✓  A permanent work and residency permit for Germany / EU.

Bonus points if you have:

◦    German language skills – that might be helpful during building great prompts

◦    Experience with voice systems, bots, or dialog platforms in production

◦    Familiarity with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar) or agentic patterns

◦    Understanding of enterprise security requirements: ISO 27001, GDPR, audit trails



Why virtualQ - Why Now?

Production-grade AI, not a lab. The infrastructure you build serves tens of thousands of real interactions for clients who can't switch off. That makes the engineering harder — and the impact real.

Greenfield on Brownfield. A mature, stable platform paired with wide-open architectural decisions on the path to AI-native. High ownership. Actual say in how things get built.

The experience flywheel. We've accumulated real-world experience over a large number of contact center deployments and use cases. That knowledge makes our models better with every new client — a compounding advantage no new entrant can replicate quickly.

Trusted by design — Made in Europe. ISO 27001 certified, GDPR-native, built for heavily regulated industries. As data sovereignty becomes strategically critical, this is a differentiator, not just a compliance checkbox.

Small team. Real ownership. A focused engineering team where you work directly with product and leadership. No ticket theater, no layers of approval. Flat hierarchy, honest feedback.



How We Hire

We keep it straightforward and respectful of your time:

1 - Intro call (45 min)

A quick conversation with engineering leadership — no trick questions, just context.

2 - Technical conversation pt. 1 (60 min)

We talk through something you've built. Your time to shine.

3 - Technical conversation pt. 2 (60-90 min)

We talk through something you’ve fixed for us ;-) Your chance to shine even more!

4 - Founder conversation (45 min)

5 - Offer

Fast feedback. We don't let decisions sit.



Ready To Build Something That Matters?

🚀 Build the Future of Global Work - From Anywhere


Traditional compliance is slow and manual. At WorkFlex, we have built the platform that automates it. We are looking for experienced Fullstack Product Engineers who want to build high-scale systems using the most advanced agentic workflows available.


The Lifestyle We are a remote-only company. You can work from a beach, a mountain, or your home office. You have 183 days of workations per year because we believe the best code is written by people who are inspired by their surroundings.


🤖 The Workflow: Orchestrating Agents over Manual Coding


At WorkFlex, we operate differently. We don't want you spending 8 hours a day manually typing boilerplate.


  • Agentic Excellence: We use tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and Lovable to handle the heavy lifting. You are the orchestrator who guides the AI to build scalable, secure, and elegant systems.
  • IDE-Light: We focus on the Architect’s Mind. If you are a senior dev who is already prompt-engineering your way to 10x productivity, you will fit right in. If you haven't mastered agents yet but are eager to learn the future of engineering, we will help you get there.


🎯 What will you do

  • Own the Product: You will be part of an autonomous team of 5, reporting to an Engineering Team Lead. You are not a ticket-taker; you work on an equal footing with Product Managers to decide what we build.
  • Fullstack Stewardship: You will balance between Java (Spring Boot) and Angular (TypeScript). Most days it is a 50/50 split, but you and your agents are comfortable shifting where the impact is needed most.
  • High-Stakes Security: Since we handle sensitive global compliance data, you own the security of your applications. From integrating best practices to thinking like a pentester, you ensure our platform remains a fortress.
  • End-to-End Delivery: From initial system design to cloud infrastructure and deployment, you and your team own the full lifecycle.


⭐What You Need to Succeed

  • Experience: 3+ years of professional experience. You have enough battle scars to know when code is good and when it is simply hallucinated by an AI.

🚀 Why join us at WorkFlex

  • Contribute to building the future of the fastest-growing HR Tech start-up in Germany backed by prominent customers such as Scout24, Vodafone, Biontech, and others, as well as funding from top-tier VC and angel investors.

title: DevOps Engineer (w/d/m) – Cloud, Automation & Security
description: Willkommen bei codecentric Wir sind ein IT-Consulting Unternehmen mit Leidenschaft für individuelle Softwarelösungen, die wirklich zu unseren Kunden passen. Gemeinsam schaffen wir innovative, nachhaltige und ganzheitliche Lösungen mit spürbarem Mehrwert. Unsere Schwerpunkte sind Retail, Insurance, Manufacturing und Energy. Unser Arbeitsumfeld basiert auf Vertrauen, Wertschätzung und gemeinsamen Lernen. Denn gute Arbeit entsteht dort, wo Menschen sich entfalten und weiterentwickeln können. In unserem internen IT-Team der codecentric AG verantwortest du den stabilen Betrieb, die kontinuierliche Optimierung und den Ausbau unserer modernen Multi-Cloud-Systemlandschaft. Ein zentraler und dynamisch wachsender Bestandteil deiner Rolle ist die Inhouse-Softwareentwicklung und Prozessautomatisierung. Dabei treiben wir die Nutzung von AI-Tools im Entwicklungsprozess aktiv voran, um innovative Lösungen noch effizienter zu gestalten. IT-Security und Governance betrachten wir hierbei als integralen Bestandteil eines modernen, zukunftssicheren Betriebs. Deine Aufgaben Multi-Cloud & Infrastructure Operations: Du übernimmst den zuverlässigen Betrieb, die Pflege und die Skalierung unserer Cloud-Umgebungen in einer Multi-Cloud-Infrastruktur (AWS, Azure und GCP) sowie der internen IT-Assets (Linux Server, MacOS, Windows Clients). Automatisierung & Softwareentwicklung (AI-supported): Du konzipierst und entwickelst softwarebasierte Lösungen zur Automatisierung interner Workflows und baust robuste APIs zur nahtlosen Integration unserer Systeme. Dabei nutzt du moderne AI-Tools im Entwicklungsprozess, um deine Workflows zu optimieren. Betriebssicherheit & Monitoring: Mittels moderner Observability-Methoden überwachst du unsere IT-Landschaft, erkennst Unregelmäßigkeiten frühzeitig und leitest Maßnahmen zur Systemhärtung ein. Vulnerability & Incident Management: Du behältst den Überblick beim CVE-Tracking, identifizierst Schwachstellen im laufenden Betrieb und unterstützt das ISMS-Team aktiv bei der Analyse und Behebung von IT-Security Incidents. Zudem wirkst du bei BCM-Simulationen mit. Zukunftsorientierte Governance: Du begleitest den Betrieb technologisch an vorderster Front, indem du Konzepte für AI-Native Security Operations mit umsetzt und die Einhaltung von AI-Governance und TOMs sicherstellst. Deine Qualifikationen Erfahrung im IT-Betrieb & Software Engineering: Du bringst eine gesunde Mischung aus Erfahrung im IT-Infrastrukturbetrieb (System Engineering / DevOps) und Kenntnissen in der Softwareentwicklung mit. Programmier-, API- & AI-Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit mindestens einer gängigen Skript- oder Programmiersprache (z. B. Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript) und hast Erfahrung im Design von APIs. Idealerweise nutzt du bereits AI-Assistenztools beim Coden, um deine Produktivität zu steigern. Multi-Cloud-Know-how: Du bewegst dich sicher in Cloud-Umgebungen – ein Schwerpunkt in AWS ist ideal, fundierte Berührungspunkte mit Microsoft Azure und/oder Google Cloud Platform (GCP) runden dein Profil ab. Tiefgehendes Wissen rund um Linux Server setzen wir voraus. Security- & Compliance-Bewusstsein: Ein starkes Bewusstsein für IT-Security (z. B. SecOps / Blue Teaming) sowie grundlegende Kenntnisse in Compliance-Themen (ISMS, ISO 27001) bringen dein Profil auf das nächste Level. Interesse an neuen Technologien: Du hast Lust, dich in zukunftswegweisende Themen wie AI-Governance und AI-Native Security einzubringen und den operativen Betrieb dahingehend mitzugestalten. Teamgeist & Kommunikation: Du arbeitest gerne im Team, überzeugst durch eine hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit sowie verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Bereitschaft zur Rufbereitschaft: Für den stabilen Betrieb unserer IT-Infrastruktur bist du bereit, im erforderlichen Rahmen eine Rufbereitschaft zu übernehmen. Das bieten wir dir Flexible Arbeitsbedingungen & Familienfreundlichkeit: Vertrauensarbeitszeit, hybride Arbeitsweise, 30 Tage Urlaub, Sonderurlaub, zukaufbarer Urlaub sowie Weihnachten und Silvester frei. Zusätzlich kannst du ein Sabbatical nehmen oder im Zeitwertkonto für besondere Lebensphase wie z.B. Rente sparen. Unterstützung bei der Kinderbetreuung erhältst du über HeyCare. Offene Unternehmenskultur: Vertrauen statt Kontrolle, Gestaltungsfreiraum, Knowledge-Sharing, Mitspracherecht und eine gelebte Fehlerkultur werden bei uns Wirklichkeit. Team & Zusammenarbeit: Du triffst auf motivierte, kluge Kolleg*innen, die ihr Wissen teilen, gemeinsam an Lösungen tüfteln und dich bei deiner Arbeit unterstützen. Wohlbefinden & Gesundheit: Wir bieten dir ein EAP-System (Employee Assistance Program), gesundheitsfördernde Maßnahmen und Coaching-Angebote, damit du sowohl beruflich als auch persönlich unterstützt wirst. Weiterbildung: Ist bei uns ein Teil deiner Arbeitszeit, den du in Absprache mit deiner Führungskraft zur Verfügung bekommst. Eigene Hardware & Geräte: Du bekommst deinen Rechner aus einer Auswahl an Mac und Lenovo Laptops. Auch das Firmenhandy wählst du aus. Beide Geräte kannst du auch privat nutzen. Deine Ansprechpartnerin Wenn du Fragen hast, melde dich gern bei mir. Katharina Feuerbach katharina.feuerbach-recruiting@codecentric.de Über uns Bei uns zählst du als Mensch – mit allem, was dich ausmacht: deinen Ideen, deinen Eigenschaften und deinen Zielen. Wir schaffen ein Umfeld, in dem du dich wohlfühlst, wachsen und Neues ausprobieren kannst. Bei uns bekommst du Rückhalt und Zeit für Entwicklung. Hier arbeitest du mit klugen, motivierten Köpfen zusammen, die ihr Wissen teilen, voneinander und miteinander lernen und gemeinsam Dinge voranbringen. Hier erfährst du mehr über unser Miteinander und Benefits: Unsere Standorte Benefits – Das bieten wir dir FAQ – Frequently Asked Questions

title: Full Stack Software Engineer, Robotic Solutions Development
description: Intrinsic is an AI robotics group at Google aiming to reimagine the potential of industrial robotics. Our team believes that advances in AI, perception and simulation will redefine what’s possible for industrial robotics in the near future – with software and data at the core. Our mission is to make industrial robotics intelligent, accessible, and usable for millions more businesses, entrepreneurs, and developers. We are a dynamic team of engineers, roboticists, designers, and technologists who are passionate about unlocking the creative and economic potential of industrial robotics. Role As a Full Stack Senior Software Engineer in our Product Development Team for Robotic Solutions you will work closely together with different stakeholders to develop production ready software for scalable robot applications based on our Intrinsic Platform. You will be part of the entire development journey, from scoping the right technical solution, analyzing dependencies and needs up to actual development and testing. How your work moves the mission forward Synchronize with product management and platform development to take the right architecture decisions, which ensure long term maintainability and stability. Implement high quality software with state of the art tooling as part of an experienced team of developers. Be hands on in testing on real hardware and supporting customers where needed. Ensure a smooth transition of feature releases to the Customer Success Team, which will take care of most customer facing enablement and support. Skills you will need to be successful Master’s degree or equivalent practical background in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related technical field. Experience implementing user facing web-based frontends and associated backends in the context of robotics and industrial automation. Professional work experience with Python + TypeScript / JavaScript. Demonstrated capability in technical leadership, including setting technical direction and guiding development efforts towards successful outcomes. Excellent collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal cross-functional teams and external technical partners. Skills that will differentiate your candidacy Proven track record developing and deploying frontend and backend production code for industrial robotics and automation solutions within manufacturing or production environments. Good understanding of concepts such as coordinate transforms, quaternions and pose representations. Familiarity with web-based 3D Visualization. Ability to drive sustainable architecture decisions and experience with appropriate testing approaches. Experience with Angular, Bazel, gRPC and Protocol Buffers. The base salary for this full-time position is between €128,000 - €131,200 (EUR) + 15% bonus + equity + benefits. Your recruiter will share more about the specific salary range + bonus + equity for your targeted location and role during the hiring process. title: Data Engineer (all genders)
description: DE45054 Data Engineer (all genders) Full-time/ permanent contract in Düsseldorf or London. We are looking for a skilled Data Engineer to join our Advanced Analytics team. As a key member of the organisation, this role is responsible for managing and optimising data storage and data models that support business-specific use cases. Working closely with cross-functional stakeholders, the Data Engineer helps enable cloud-based machine learning initiatives and supports the technical infrastructure required for scalable analytics solutions. Key Responsibilities Design, build and optimize scalable data pipelines and ELT/ETL processes to deliver trusted data across cloud platforms aligned with business and analytics needs. Monitor and troubleshoot data pipelines, platform performance and data issues while maintaining data quality, integrity, availability and reliability. Contribute to cloud data architecture, data models and engineering standards, and support improvements in tooling, automation, documentation and deployment processes. Work closely with data scientists, analysts, product owners and business stakeholders to deliver fit-for-purpose data solutions and communicate technical topics clearly. Stay up to date with emerging cloud, data engineering and automation technologies, and apply new tools and methods where appropriate. WhyBrilliant | Berlin (Hybrid) | Full-time | Founding Team Competitive salary + meaningful equity


Voice + LLM Platform (0→1) | Technical Hire #2


Hiring is drowning in noise. CVs and dashboards don’t create understanding. Conversations do.


We’re building WhyBrilliant, a voice-first hiring platform and market network: two voice agents (company + candidate) connected by an insight engine that turns conversations into structured signal—and turns recruiter fees into platform revenue. Career clarity, served hot.


We’re backed by Merantix Capital, one of Europe’s leading Tier 1 AI investors. You’ll join an experienced founder team (product + platform + go-to-market) with early traction already on the board—and a very big ambition for 2026.


This is a massive market. Hiring is a multi-hundred-billion € mess globally, and it’s ready for a new system built on conversations, not forms.


The Exciting Problems You’ll Solve


The heart of WhyBrilliant is a matching engine that doesn’t just "keyword match" CVs. It builds structured truth from messy, human conversations. If you like building systems where product, data, and models collide—this is the main course.


You’ll help us build an engine that can:


  • Extract Signal: Turn voice conversations into clean, reusable signal (skills, intent, constraints, seniority, comp, motivation, culture cues).


  • Reimagine Roles: Model roles as outcome-based success profiles, not static job ads.


  • Ensure Transparency: Do matching that’s explainable (why this person, why this role) instead of relying on black-box vibes.


  • Drive Feedback Loops: Learn over time using signals from the marketplace (interview outcomes, hiring decisions, retention proxies).


  • Build Defensibility: Stay robust against garbage input, prompt attacks, and "creative storytelling" from both sides.


  • Perform at Scale: Work fast and reliably under real constraints (latency, cost, privacy, compliance).


What You’ll Do (Day-to-Day)


  • This is a founding seat. You’ll own real surface area: architecture, implementation, and hard trade-offs—and you’ll ship fast.


  • End-to-End Build: Construct the core platform from scratch (candidate + employer experience, dashboards, data layer).


  • AI Orchestration: Ship LLM-powered systems including orchestration, retrieval, structured extraction, evaluation, and matching.


  • Voice Engineering: Make voice production-grade by optimizing latency, reliability, flow design, and creating a "this actually feels good" UX.


  • Security by Design: Build a secure stack (auth, secrets, isolation, logging, abuse prevention, safe data handling).


  • Technical Leadership: Own architecture and technical decisions end-to-end, keeping them highly pragmatic.


The Stack (Today)


If you have strong opinions here: great. Bring them. This is a 0→1 build, not a "maintain legacy" job.


  • TypeScript: Next.js
  • Python: FastAPI, async services
  • Database: Postgres (structured + unstructured + vector)
  • Cloud: Modern cloud tooling (optimized for speed + reliability)
  • AI/Voice: Leading LLM providers + modern voice infrastructure


What We’re Looking For


This is not a "tickets in Jira" job. It’s an ownership job.


  • Core Languages: Strong experience with TypeScript (Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, async systems).


  • AI/ML Experience: Proven experience building LLM and ML-based systems (ideally in production, or very close to it).


  • Architecture & Ownership: You’ve owned architecture end-to-end before (or you’ve been the person everyone relied on).


  • Security Mindset: You bake best practices and security into how you build from day one.


  • Execution: You are a hands-on, pragmatic, and fast shipper.


  • Modern Workflows: Excited about AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex)—and you actually use them.


  • Bonus points if you have: Built low-latency systems, developed voice UX, or worked on data-heavy products dealing with messy inputs.


Why Join?


  • Maximum Leverage: As Technical Hire #2, you have maximum ownership and no passenger seats.


  • Real Upside: Meaningful equity—you are building the core.


  • Top-Tier Comp: Competitive compensation (cash + equity); we want A-players, not bargains.


  • Strong Backing: Supported by Merantix Capital (and the Merantix AI Campus ecosystem), meaning a high bar, high support, and serious ambition.


  • Rare Timing: Voice + LLMs are finally good enough to reshape workflows people actually hate.


  • Clear Mission: Reduce noise, increase signal, and make hiring feel human again—at scale.

About us

Getsafe guides people to make smart life choices with personalized digital insurance.


We’re reinventing insurance from the ground up: with our own tech platform and a single app that unites property, life, and health coverage in one seamless experience. Features like family accounts, AI-powered guidance, instant claims handling, and our prevention program “Safepoints” make insurance simple, transparent, and built for today.


Since our launch in 2018, we’ve grown from our headquarters in Heidelberg and office in Berlin to serving more than 500,000 customers across Germany, Austria, and France. Backed by €120M from leading investors such as Earlybird, CommerzVentures, and Swiss Re, we’ve become one of Europe’s fastest-growing insurtechs.


Learn more about us on our Website, Instagram or on LinkedIn.


What we're looking for

We are seeking an experienced Senior Backend Engineer to join our growth team. Our growth team’s mission is to keep our customers and operations teams happy by building the Insurance Platform parts used for insurance product launches, policy administration, marketing and sales.


In this role, you will work on backend features of our insurance platform while also contributing to internal tools and automation that improve efficiency for engineering and other teams across the company. This includes building systems and emerging agentic tooling that streamline workflows, reduce operational overhead, and enable teams to move faster.


What you will do

  • Collaborate with the team and stakeholders to define and implement the vision for a scalable system architecture for our insurance platform that supports our growing portfolio and customer base.
  • Own and contribute to our evolving list of internal tools starting with Ruby libraries and agentic tools in engineering and beyond.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code that promotes best practices and enables others.
  • Explore and propose new technologies to streamline processes and improve system efficiency.
  • Champion engineering best practices and help elevate our tech stack to the next level, setting standards for the organization.
  • Create reusable solutions that help teams scale faster and avoid one-off workarounds.


About you

  • Experience: 5+ years of backend development experience, working on complex systems and platform solutions.
  • Strong passion for building, maintaining, and improving platform tooling, libraries, solutions, and processes that empower multiple engineering teams and enhance the overall developer experience.
  • Ruby on Rails: Solid experience with Ruby on Rails and a deep understanding of how to develop high-quality, reliable software.
  • Agentic Engineering: Good understanding of working with coding agents from planning to delivery.
  • Collaboration: Strong communicator, able to work across teams and translate technical vision into actionable plans.
  • Problem-Solving: You can break down complex problems into manageable parts and communicate solutions clearly to your team and other stakeholders.
  • Quality-Driven: Commitment to delivering solutions that are well-tested, reliable, and maintainable.
  • Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes and AWS is a plus.
  • Proven experience in fintech environments or startups is a plus.


Our stack

  • Distributed architecture of 10+ independent RESTful services
  • Ruby on Rails
  • PostgreSQL, Kafka, Sidekiq, Redis
  • Terraform, Qovery (Kubernetes) and AWS
  • Datadog


How we work

Customer Empathy

We simplify insurance by aligning our vision with every interaction, maintaining transparency, and building togetherness and trust with our customers.


Absolute Ownership

We pursue excellence relentlessly, taking full ownership, and ensuring everyone knows their role to contribute to our mission.


Day One Mindset

We strive to continually act as pacemakers, constantly optimising, thinking ahead, and inspiring greatness to build a scalable and impactful future.


Driver Team

We communicate effectively, collaborate positively, and drive success as equals, united by respect and an inspiring mission.


What we offer

  • Front row seat at one of Europe’s leading insurtechs that redefines how millions of people experience insurance every day
  • Diverse and high-performing team that thrives on ownership, speed, and constantly raising the bar
  • Hybrid or on-site setup across our hubs in Heidelberg (Europaplatz) and Berlin (Eberswalder Straße)
  • Competitive salary plus company-wide VSOP program
  • Claude Max and the latest hardware and productivity tools
  • €1,000 annual development budget
  • €50 monthly benefit budget
  • Monthly Getsafe insurance voucher
  • 28 vacation days plus birthday and December 24th & 31st off
  • 90 workation days within the EU


We're looking for great people, not perfect résumés. If you're excited about what we're building and think you could make a great addition to the team, we encourage you to apply – even if you don't meet every single requirement. We'd love to hear from you!


We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.


We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other legally protected characteristics.
